eight_input_certificate.theorem: Eight orthogonal basis encodings differ only on the three held wires. Preserving their distinctions with the other 34 wires unchanged requires dimension at least 8, hence at least 3 qubits. Any projection along a nonzero direction supported on the three held wires has collisions. Any attempted reconstruction from the remaining unchanged data fails on one certified pair.
